definition_zh: 证词；证言；见证；（对某事的）明证
definition_en: a formal statement, especially one made under oath in court, that something is true
core_image: 证人站在庭上，手按誓词，把所见一句一句说给速记员
scene: 证人席上的人举起手，速记员开始敲下他说的每一句。Her testimony lasted nearly three hours.
sceneCN: 这里 testimony 指证人在法庭上给出的证词（第 1 个义项：法庭上作出的正式陈述）；句意为她的证词持续了将近三个小时。图中可辨识物件：证人席、速记键盘、誓词卡、记者笔记本。

pos.zh: 证词；证言（法律）
见证；明证；公开的陈述

derivatives.zh: 遗嘱；证明（同出 testari 词根）

senses.title: Sworn statement in court
senses.definition: a formal statement made under oath by a witness in a legal proceeding
senses.definitionCN: 证人在法律程序中宣誓后作出的正式陈述
senses.example: Her testimony lasted nearly three hours.
senses.exampleCN: 她的证词持续了将近三个小时。
senses.why: Testimony comes from Latin testimonium, built on testis 'witness': it is the words a witness contributes to a case.
senses.whyCN: testimony 出自拉丁 testimonium，词根是 testis「证人」：它是证人为案件提供的言辞。

senses.title: Expert evidence
senses.definition: the statement of a specialist explaining technical matters to a court
senses.definitionCN: 专家向法庭解释专门问题的陈述
senses.example: The geologist's testimony turned on the age of the layer.
senses.exampleCN: 地质学家的证言关键在于那一层的年代。
senses.why: A specialist is still a witness, so the word covers informed opinion as well as eyewitness fact.
senses.whyCN: 专家同样是证人，因此这个词既指亲见的事实，也指有依据的专业判断。

senses.title: Bearing witness to something
senses.definition: a public act of confirming something one has seen or known
senses.definitionCN: 公开确认自己所见所知的行为
senses.example: Her letters bear testimony to a long friendship.
senses.exampleCN: 她的书信见证了长久的友谊。
senses.why: The old phrase bear testimony keeps the witness in view while the object shifts from a crime to a relationship.
senses.whyCN: 「作见证」这一旧说法仍保留「见证人」的意思，只是对象从罪行换成了关系。

senses.title: A clear sign of something
senses.definition: something that serves as clear proof of a quality or an event
senses.definitionCN: 作为某品质或某事件的明确证明的事物
senses.example: The rebuilt square is testimony to the city's recovery.
senses.exampleCN: 重建的广场是该城复苏的明证。
senses.why: When an object testifies, it does what a witness does: it makes a fact publicly undeniable.
senses.whyCN: 当一件物品「作证」时，它做的事与证人相同：让某项事实变得公开而无可否认。

senses.title: Written statement
senses.definition: a written statement sworn or affirmed before a person with authority
senses.definitionCN: 在有权者面前宣誓或确认的书面陈述
senses.example: The clerk read the written testimony into the record.
senses.exampleCN: 书记员把书面证词读入案卷。
senses.why: Procedure accepts words on paper as testimony, so the noun covers documents as well as speech.
senses.whyCN: 程序法承认纸面文字同样构成证词，因此这个词也指文件。

senses.title: The voices of many witnesses
senses.definition: the collected statements of several witnesses considered together
senses.definitionCN: 把若干证人的陈述合并考察
senses.example: The testimony of the passengers contradicted the driver's account.
senses.exampleCN: 乘客们的证词与司机的说法相矛盾。
senses.why: The uncountable use treats many statements as one body of evidence.
senses.whyCN: 不可数用法把许多陈述当成一整份证据。

senses.title: Public declaration of faith
senses.titleCN: 宗教集会中的信仰见证
senses.definition: a personal account of religious experience given to a congregation
senses.definitionCN: 在会众面前讲述个人宗教经历的陈述
senses.example: He gave his testimony before the congregation at the spring meeting.
senses.exampleCN: 他在春季聚会上向会众讲述了自己的信仰见证。
senses.why: Religious communities borrowed the legal noun for a statement whose truth rests on the speaker's own life.
senses.whyCN: 宗教群体借用了这个法律名词，用来指以讲述者自身经历为凭的陈述。

senses.title: Statement to an inquiry
senses.titleCN: 听证会或调查中的正式陈述
senses.definition: a formal statement given to a committee, commission or investigation
senses.definitionCN: 向委员会、调查组或听证会作出的正式陈述
senses.example: Her testimony before the committee was released in full.
senses.exampleCN: 她在委员会上的证词被全文公布。
senses.why: Outside a courtroom the noun still means a formal statement on oath, which is why hearings use it.
senses.whyCN: 在法庭之外，这个词仍指正式宣誓的陈述，因此听证会沿用它。

intro.en: Testimony comes through Anglo-French from Latin testimonium 'evidence, witness', built on testis 'witness' plus the noun suffix -monium. It is recorded in English from the thirteenth century. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: testimony 经盎格鲁—法语来自拉丁 testimonium「证据、见证」，由 testis「证人」加名词后缀 -monium 构成，十三世纪起在英语中有记录。年代均为约数。

items.en: Testis meant 'witness'. Its deeper origin is not established; the suggestion that it began as 'third person standing by' is a reconstruction, not a recorded form.
items.cn: testis 意为「证人」。其更深来源未获证明；认为它原指「站在一旁的第三人」的说法属于重构，而非有记录的形式。

items.en: Testis plus -monium produced testimonium 'evidence, testimony, proof'.
items.cn: testis 加 -monium 构成 testimonium「证据、证词、证明」。

items.en: Anglo-French carried the noun into English law in the thirteenth century.
items.cn: 盎格鲁—法语在十三世纪把这个名词带入英格兰的法律用语。

items.en: From the first records testimony meant the statement of a witness, given in a case and open to challenge.
items.cn: 从最早的书证起，testimony 就指证人在案件中作出、可被质疑的陈述。

items.en: In the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries the noun widened to public declarations of faith and to any clear sign of a fact.
items.cn: 十六、十七世纪，这个名词扩展到公开的信仰陈述以及任何明确的事实迹象。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin): the pre-Latin history of testis is a reconstruction, and the exact first English citation is uncertain. The anatomical testis is a separate homonym and no derivation from the witness word is demonstrated.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源）：testis 在拉丁语之前的历史属于重构，英语最早书证的确切年代不确定。解剖学意义上的 testis 是另一个同形词，尚无证据显示它由「证人」这个词派生。

note.en: Group one holds words from the same testis stock that are often confused; group two holds the kinds of statement a case may rest on.
note.cn: 第一组是同出 testis 词干、常被混淆的词；第二组是一桩案件可能依据的各类陈述。

entries.definition: From testari 'to make a will', built on testis: a document declaring one's wishes after death.
entries.definitionCN: 出自 testari「立遗嘱」，词根为 testis：声明身后意愿的文件。

entries.definition: A letter testifying to a person's character or service, rather than words spoken in court.
entries.definitionCN: 证明某人品行或工作经历的信件，而不是庭上说的话。

entries.definition: A legal adjective for someone who has left a valid will, from the will-making sense of testari.
entries.definitionCN: 法律形容词，指留下有效遗嘱的人，取自 testari 的立遗嘱义。

entries.definition: An anatomical word from Latin testiculus; its relation to the witness word is not demonstrated.
entries.definitionCN: 解剖学术语，出自拉丁 testiculus；它与「证人」一词的关系未获证明。

entries.definition: The broad term for anything that proves a fact, of which testimony is one kind.
entries.definitionCN: 指一切能证明事实的材料，证词只是其中一类。

entries.definition: A plain account of facts; it need not be sworn or given in court.
entries.definitionCN: 对事实的平实陈述，不必宣誓，也不必须在法庭作出。

entries.definition: A written statement confirmed by oath or affirmation, usually for use in legal proceedings.
entries.definitionCN: 经宣誓或确认的书面陈述，通常用于法律程序。

entries.definition: Sworn testimony recorded out of court before trial, used later as evidence.
entries.definitionCN: 审前在庭外录取的宣誓证词，供日后作为证据使用。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Testis 'witness' plus -monium: the words a witness brings.
normal.cn: testis「证人」加 -monium：证人带来的言辞。

normal.en: The family runs testify, testimony, testifier, testimonial.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 testify、testimony、testifier 与 testimonial。

normal.en: Courts say give testimony and hear testimony; reporters say sworn testimony.
normal.cn: 法庭上说「提供证词」「听取证词」，报道里说「宣誓证词」。

normal.en: The abstract use is testimony to something: testimony to her patience.
normal.cn: 抽象用法是 testimony to：对她的耐心的明证。

normal.en: The anatomical testicle is a separate homonym, not a relative proved by derivation.
normal.cn: 解剖学上的 testicle 是另一个同形词，并非已证实的同族词。

abstract.en: Picture a hand raised over a book before the first sentence is spoken.
abstract.cn: 想象在说出第一句之前，一只手先按在书上。

abstract.en: Picture a stone plaque that keeps saying what happened long after the witnesses have gone.
abstract.cn: 想象一块石牌，在证人都不在了之后仍不断说明发生过什么。

abstract.en: Picture a room where many separate voices are folded into one page.
abstract.cn: 想象许多彼此独立的声音被折进同一页纸里。

examples.en: The court heard testimony from six witnesses in two days.
examples.cn: 法庭在两天内听取了六名证人的证词。

examples.en: The broken tools are testimony to how little the crew had to work with.
examples.cn: 这些破损的工具说明施工队手里的条件多么有限。

examples.en: Her testimony to the commission was published with the exhibits.
examples.cn: 她向委员会所作的证词连同证物一并公布。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「test（作证）+ imony」——站在证人席上说出所见：证词、见证

root: 拉丁 testimonium「证据、见证」= testis「证人」+ -monium；testis 更深来源不确定，与解剖学同形词无已证实的派生关系。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses keep one witness in place while its voice moves: a sworn statement, an expert opinion, a public act of witnessing, a sign left by events, a written page, the combined voices of many, a declaration of faith and a statement to an inquiry.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项让同一位证人留在原处，只让他的声音移动：宣誓陈述、专家意见、公开见证、事件留下的明证、书面页、众人之声的合并、信仰陈述，以及向调查组的正式陈说。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a witness at the stand with one hand raised, speaking sentence by sentence to a recorder.
core.cn: 核心意象：证人站在证人席上，一只手举起，一句一句地对速记员说话。

branches.en: THE SWORN VOICE: the same stand holds an eyewitness and a specialist explaining a field.
branches.cn: 宣誓的声音：同一个证人席上，既站着目击者，也站着解释专业的专家。

branches.en: BEYOND THE COURT: a life and a rebuilt square can both testify to something without speaking.
branches.cn: 走出法庭：一段人生与一座重建的广场都能不发一言地作证。

branches.en: ON PAPER: the statement is sworn in writing and read into the record.
branches.cn: 落在纸上：陈述以书面形式宣誓，再被读入案卷。

branches.en: MANY AT ONCE: separate statements are gathered into one body of testimony.
branches.cn: 多人同时：各自独立的陈述被汇成一份证词总体。

branches.en: ELSEWHERE SPEAKING: a congregation and a commission both ask for a formal personal account.
branches.cn: 在别处陈说：会众与调查委员会都要一份正式的个人陈述。

intro.en: Testimony is a Latin noun whose root, suffix and relatives all remain readable in English.
intro.cn: testimony 是一个拉丁名词，其词根、后缀与同族词在英语中仍然可读。

latinIntro.en: Latin testis 'witness' gives testimony, testify, testament and testimonial, all through the act of calling a witness.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 testis「证人」衍生 testimony、testify、testament 与 testimonial，都经由「传唤证人」这一动作。

items.example: The root names the person who speaks.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根指出面说话的人。

items.example: The suffix turns the witness into the evidence produced.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把「证人」转成由其产生的证据。

items.example: The testimony filled forty pages.
items.exampleCN: 证词写满了四十页。

items.example: Two neighbours testified.
items.exampleCN: 两位邻居作了证。

items.example: The testifier asked for protection.
items.exampleCN: 作证者要求保护。

items.example: The firm supplied a testimonial.
items.exampleCN: 这家公司出具了一封证明信。

items.example: The will was read as a testament.
items.exampleCN: 这份遗嘱被当作郑重声明宣读。

items.example: Two clerks attested the signature.
items.exampleCN: 两名职员证明了签名的真实性。

definition_zh: 纺织品；织物；纺织原料；纺织的
definition_en: cloth made by weaving or knitting, or the material from which such cloth is made
core_image: 无数细线在织机上纵横交错，最后压成一整匹平整的布
scene: 工厂把成卷的棉纱送进织机，出来时已是一整匹布。The mill fed rolls of cotton yarn into the loom, and a bolt of textile came out.
sceneCN: 这里指「织成的布匹」（第 1 个义项：纺织成品）；句意为工厂把成卷的棉纱送进织机，出来时已是一整匹纺织品。可辨识物件：棉纱卷、织机、布匹、传送带。

pos.zh: 纺织品；织物；纺织原料
纺织的；织物的

derivatives.zh: 纺织产品；纺织业（由基础词加表示复数的后缀构成，语义偏移为商品类别与行业）
纺织品设计师（由基础词与表示「设计师」的词复合，语义收窄为职业）
以纺织材料为基础的（由基础词与表示「以……为基础」的词复合，语义偏移为材料属性）
类似纺织品的（由基础词加表示「像……的」后缀构成，语义偏移为性质描述）

senses.title: Woven cloth
senses.definition: cloth produced by weaving, knitting or another fabric-making process
senses.definitionCN: 通过机织、针织或其他制布工艺生产出来的布
senses.example: A bolt of textile came out of the loom.
senses.exampleCN: 一整匹布从织机里出来。
senses.why: The word comes from a Latin verb meaning 'to weave'. A textile is literally a woven thing, so the sense begins with the finished cloth.
senses.whyCN: 这个词来自一个意为「编织」的拉丁动词。纺织品字面上就是「被织成的东西」，因此词义从成品布开始。

senses.title: The textile industry
senses.definition: the industry that makes cloth, usually referred to in the plural
senses.definitionCN: 制造布料的工业，通常用复数形式指整个行业
senses.example: The town's textiles employed half its workers.
senses.exampleCN: 这座镇的纺织业雇用了半数工人。
senses.why: An industry named after its product uses the plural to mean the sector as a whole, not a pile of individual cloths.
senses.whyCN: 以产品命名的行业用复数指整个部门，而不是指一堆具体的布。

senses.title: Fibre material for cloth
senses.definition: the fibre, yarn or filament from which cloth is made
senses.definitionCN: 用来制作布料的纤维、纱线或长丝
senses.example: The lab tests textile before it reaches the loom.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室在原料上织机之前先做检测。
senses.why: Because the finished cloth and its material are stages of one process, the same noun serves for both, distinguished by context.
senses.whyCN: 成品布与原料是同一过程的不同阶段，因此同一个名词兼指两者，靠语境区分。

senses.title: Relating to cloth
senses.titleCN: 形容词义：与织物有关的
senses.definition: used before a noun to mean 'of cloth, weaving or the cloth trade'
senses.definitionCN: 用在名词前，表示「织物的、织造的或纺织业的」
senses.example: Textile exports rose for the third year.
senses.exampleCN: 纺织品出口连续第三年增长。
senses.why: As an adjective the word simply labels a field, so textile exports or textile design means the cloth sector rather than a particular cloth.
senses.whyCN: 作形容词时，这个词只是给一个领域贴标签，因此纺织品出口或纺织品设计指的是布料行业，而非某一块布。

senses.title: Industrial and technical fabrics
senses.definition: engineered fabrics made for strength, filtration, protection or other technical uses
senses.definitionCN: 为强度、过滤、防护等技术用途而设计的织物
senses.example: The car uses technical textile in its seats.
senses.exampleCN: 这辆车的座椅用了技术纺织品。
senses.why: Modern fibres can be designed for a job rather than for appearance, so the word now covers fabrics that never reach a wardrobe.
senses.whyCN: 现代纤维可以为功能而非外观来设计，因此这个词现在也涵盖根本不会进入衣柜的织物。

senses.title: Non-woven fabric
senses.definition: fabric made by bonding or felting fibres rather than by weaving them
senses.definitionCN: 通过黏合或毡合纤维、而非编织制成的布
senses.example: The mask is made of non-woven textile.
senses.exampleCN: 这只口罩由非织造布制成。
senses.why: The category expanded past its own etymology: cloth can now be made without a loom, yet it still belongs to the textile family.
senses.whyCN: 这个类别超出了自身的词源：如今不用织机也能制布，但它仍属于纺织品家族。

senses.title: Textile design as a field
senses.definition: the discipline of designing patterns, structures and surfaces for cloth
senses.definitionCN: 为布料设计图案、结构与表面的学科
senses.example: She studied textile at an art school.
senses.exampleCN: 她在艺术学校学习纺织品设计。
senses.why: Once cloth became a designed surface, the noun named a course of study and a profession, not only a material.
senses.whyCN: 当布料成为被设计的表面，这个名词就指一门课程与一种职业，而不只是材料。

senses.title: Household textile goods
senses.definition: cloth goods sold for the home, such as bedding, towels and curtains, usually in the plural
senses.definitionCN: 面向家庭销售的布制品，如床品、毛巾与窗帘，通常用复数
senses.example: The shop sells home textiles on the ground floor.
senses.exampleCN: 这家店在一层卖家用纺织品。
senses.why: Retail groups cloth by where it is used. The plural marks a product category rather than any single woven piece.
senses.whyCN: 零售业按使用场所给布料分类。复数标记的是一个商品类别，而不是某一件织物。

intro.en: Textile comes from a Latin adjective meaning 'woven', built on the verb texere 'to weave'. The same verb also gives text, texture, context and tissue. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: textile 来自一个意为「织成的」的拉丁形容词，其动词是 texere「编织」。同一个动词还给出 text、texture、context 与 tissue。年代均为约数。

items.en: Latin texere meant 'to weave, plait, construct'. A text was first something woven, and only later something written.
items.cn: 拉丁 texere 意为「编织、编结、构造」。最初 text 指织成的东西，后来才指写成的东西。

items.en: The adjective textilis 'woven, able to be woven' produced the noun textilis in later usage, and English took the adjective directly.
items.cn: 形容词 textilis 意为「织成的、可织的」，在后来的用法中产生名词形式；英语直接借入了这个形容词。

items.en: French textile mediated the word in the seventeenth century, when cloth manufacture was becoming an organised trade in Europe.
items.cn: 法语 textile 在十七世纪传递了这个词；当时布料制造在欧洲正变成有组织的行业。

items.en: With mechanised spinning and weaving, textile became the standard word for mill-made cloth and for the industry itself.
items.cn: 随着机械化纺纱与织造，textile 成为工厂制布以及整个行业的标准词。

items.en: Synthetic and non-woven fibres widened the word in the twentieth century, so it now covers fabrics that are not woven at all.
items.cn: 合成纤维与非织造纤维在二十世纪拓宽了这个词，因此它现在也涵盖根本不经编织的布。

items.en: Source uncertain: the origin of texere before Latin is unsettled, and the Indo-European root often cited for it is a reconstructed form rather than a recorded word.
items.cn: 来源不确定：texere 在拉丁语之前的来源没有定论，常被引用的印欧词根属于重构形式，而非有记录的真实词形。

note.en: Group one holds words from the same weaving root that now mean different things; group two holds everyday words for cloth.
note.cn: 第一组是同出「编织」词根、但现在意思不同的词；第二组是表示布料的日常词。

entries.definition: relating to a text or wording; it shares the weaving root but followed the written branch.
entries.definitionCN: 与文本或措辞有关的；它共享编织词根，却走了「书写」这一支。

entries.definition: the feel or arrangement of a surface; it keeps the woven image as a quality rather than an object.
entries.definitionCN: 表面的手感或结构；它把编织意象保留为一种性质，而非物件。

entries.definition: written or printed words; historically 'that which is woven', now entirely separated from cloth.
entries.definitionCN: 书写或印刷的文字；历史上意为「织成之物」，如今已与布料完全分开。

entries.definition: the words around a passage, literally 'woven together'; it belongs to the writing branch, not the cloth trade.
entries.definitionCN: 一段文字周围的词语，字面义为「织在一起」；它属于书写分支，而非纺织行业。

entries.definition: cloth or any material made by joining parts; from Latin fabrica 'workshop', it stresses manufacture rather than weaving.
entries.definitionCN: 布料或任何由部件构成的材料；来自拉丁 fabrica「作坊」，强调制造而非编织。

entries.definition: the common word for woven material; it is plainer and less industrial than textile.
entries.definitionCN: 指织物的普通词；比 textile 更朴素，也更少工业色彩。

entries.definition: any substance used to make something; it is broader than textile and says nothing about weaving.
entries.definitionCN: 用来制作某物的任何物质；比 textile 宽泛，不涉及编织。

entries.definition: cloth arranged in folds as curtains or hangings; it names a use of fabric rather than the fabric itself.
entries.definitionCN: 以褶皱形式布置成窗帘或悬挂物的布；它指布料的用途，而非布料本身。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The root means 'to weave', so textile is literally 'the woven thing'.
normal.cn: 词根意为「编织」，所以 textile 字面上就是「被织成的东西」。

normal.en: Text, texture and context come from the same verb, which is why a text can be described as woven.
normal.cn: text、texture 与 context 都出自同一个动词，这也是为什么一篇文本可以被形容为「织成」的。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the industry: textile industry, textile mill, textile production.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出行业：纺织工业、纺织厂、纺织品生产。

normal.en: The plural textiles names goods and the sector, not several separate cloths.
normal.cn: 复数形式指商品与行业部门，而不是几块分开的布。

normal.en: Technical textile shows that modern fabrics may be engineered rather than woven.
normal.cn: 技术纺织品说明现代织物可以是设计出来的，而不一定是织出来的。

abstract.en: Picture thousands of threads that only become a surface when they cross.
abstract.cn: 想象成千上万根线，只有交错之后才成为一片表面。

abstract.en: Picture a word and a cloth made by the same gesture of binding strands.
abstract.cn: 想象一个词与一块布，由同一个「把线束在一起」的动作做成。

abstract.en: Picture a material that can be flat, stiff, soft or filtering without changing its name.
abstract.cn: 想象一种材料，可以是平的、硬的、软的或用于过滤，却不必改名。

examples.en: The museum displays textile from the eighteenth-century mill.
examples.cn: 博物馆展出十八世纪工厂生产的纺织品。

examples.en: Textile workers demanded cleaner air in the spinning rooms.
examples.cn: 纺织工人要求在纺纱车间里呼吸更干净的空气。

examples.en: The designers mixed textile with recycled plastic.
examples.cn: 设计师把织物与再生塑料混用。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「特克斯太尔」—— 把特别细密的线一根根织成整匹布 → 纺织品

root: 拉丁 textilis「织成的」，来自 texere「编织、编结」；同一动词还派生 text、texture、context、tissue。texere 在拉丁语之前的来源不确定，常见印欧词根属重构形式。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one process: fibres are woven into cloth, cloth becomes an industry, a material, a field of design and a retail category, and finally a family of engineered fabrics that need no loom.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一过程展开：纤维被织成布，布再成为行业、材料、设计领域与零售类别，最后成为一个无需织机的工程织物家族。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: thousands of threads crossing on a loom until they hold together as one surface.
core.cn: 核心意象：成千上万根线在织机上交错，直到合成一整片表面。

branches.en: FROM FIBRE TO CLOTH: the material and the finished cloth are two ends of one process.
branches.cn: 从纤维到布：原料与成品布是同一过程的两端。

branches.en: GOODS AND SECTOR: the plural covers both mill products and the trade that makes them.
branches.cn: 商品与行业：复数形式既涵盖工厂产品，也涵盖制造它们的行业。

branches.en: AS A LABEL: the adjective marks anything belonging to cloth or the cloth trade.
branches.cn: 作为标签：形容词标记任何属于布料或纺织业的事物。

branches.en: BEYOND WEAVING: technical and non-woven fabrics keep the family name after leaving the loom.
branches.cn: 超越编织：技术织物与非织造布在离开织机后仍保留这个家族名称。

branches.en: AS DISCIPLINE: design turns cloth into a subject with patterns, structures and training.
branches.cn: 作为学科：设计把布料变成一门有图案、结构与训练体系的科目。

intro.en: Textile is one branch of a large Latin family built on weaving. The same root reaches writing, surface feel and the surrounding words of a passage.
intro.cn: textile 是以「编织」为核心的一大型拉丁词族中的一支。同一词根还通到书写、表面手感以及一段文字周围的词语。

latinIntro.en: Latin texere gives textile, text, texture, context and tissue; the past participle textus is literally 'a woven thing'.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 texere 给出 textile、text、texture、context 与 tissue；过去分词 textus 字面义就是「织成之物」。

items.structure: texere, texui, textum (Latin verb, third conjugation)
items.example: The verb covers both cloth and language.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词既覆盖布料，也覆盖语言。

items.example: The root appears in both fabric and writing.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根同时出现在织物与书写中。

items.example: The adjective became the English noun.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词变成了英语名词。

items.example: Textile fills the mill's output.
items.exampleCN: 纺织品构成工厂的产出。

items.meaning: the feel or arrangement of a surface
items.example: The texture of the cloth is coarse.
items.exampleCN: 这块布的手感粗糙。

items.example: The text runs to forty pages.
items.exampleCN: 正文长达四十页。

items.meaning: the words woven around a passage
items.meaningCN: 环绕一段文字的上下文
items.example: Read the sentence in context.
items.exampleCN: 把这个句子放在上下文中读。

items.example: The word first meant a ribbon of cloth.
items.exampleCN: 这个词最初指一条布带。

items.example: Textiles dominate the region's exports.
items.exampleCN: 纺织品占该地区出口的主要部分。

items.meaning: a person who designs cloth patterns
items.example: The textile designer works with jacquard looms.
items.exampleCN: 这位纺织品设计师使用提花织机工作。

items.example: The wall has a textile-like finish.
items.exampleCN: 这面墙有类似织物的饰面。

definition_zh: 质地；纹理；口感；（音乐、文字的）肌理；织物结构
definition_en: the feel or visible grain of a surface; the way a material or a piece of music or writing is woven together
core_image: 一块布被手指反复摩过，经纬线一高一低，光斜着照过来，表面因此有了起伏
scene: 陶艺工作台上摆着一只刚出窑的粗陶碗，指尖抚过釉面上一圈圈细密的起伏，She runs her thumb along the rim to feel the texture of the glaze.
sceneCN: 这里 texture 指「手触摸到的表面质地」（第 1 个义项：触摸所感的表面质感）；句意为她让拇指沿碗口滑过，去感受釉面的质地。图中可辨识物件：粗陶碗、带细密起伏的釉面、工作台与握着碗的手指。

pos.zh: 质地；纹理；口感；肌理
使具有某种质感；给……加纹理

senses.title: The feel of a surface under the hand
senses.definition: the way a surface feels when touched, especially its roughness, smoothness or grain
senses.definitionCN: 表面被触摸时的感觉，尤指其粗糙、光滑或颗粒感
senses.example: The texture of the stone wall is rough under her palm.
senses.exampleCN: 石墙的质地在她掌心下显得粗糙。
senses.why: Latin textura meant 'weaving' and 'fabric'; the hand reading a surface repeats the action of fingers reading cloth.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 textura 意为「编织、织物」；手去读一块表面，重复的正是手指读布的动作。

senses.title: The visible grain of a surface
senses.definition: the visual quality of a surface as shown by small variations of light, colour or relief
senses.definitionCN: 表面因光线、色彩或凹凸的细微变化而呈现的视觉性质
senses.example: The painter builds texture with short, thick strokes of paint.
senses.exampleCN: 画家用短而厚的笔触堆出纹理。
senses.why: The sense moves from touch to sight: the eye learns to read the same small variations that the fingers feel.
senses.whyCN: 词义从触觉转向视觉：眼睛学会读取手指所感到的同一批细微变化。

senses.title: The woven structure of cloth
senses.titleCN: 织物由纱线交织而成的结构
senses.definition: the way threads are woven together in a fabric, producing its weight and drape
senses.definitionCN: 织物中纱线交织的方式，决定其重量与垂感
senses.example: The coat's heavy texture comes from tightly woven wool.
senses.exampleCN: 这件大衣厚重的质地来自织得紧密的羊毛。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense: textura named the act and result of weaving before it named the feel of anything else.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的一层：textura 先指编织的动作与结果，后来才指其他事物的手感。

senses.title: The feel of food in the mouth
senses.definition: the physical quality of food as felt in the mouth, such as creaminess, crunch or grain
senses.definitionCN: 食物在口中被感受到的物理性质，如细腻、酥脆或颗粒感
senses.example: The soup has a silky texture that comes from slow cooking.
senses.exampleCN: 这汤有丝滑的口感，来自长时间的慢煮。
senses.why: The mouth takes over from the hand: chewing and pressing give the same report about grain and resistance.
senses.whyCN: 口取代了手：咀嚼与挤压给出的，是关于颗粒与阻力的同一份报告。

senses.title: The characteristic quality of a sound or a piece of writing
senses.titleCN: 声音或文字特有的质感
senses.definition: the overall character of a sound, a voice or a piece of writing, considered as a fabric of detail
senses.definitionCN: 声音、嗓音或文字整体的特质，被视为由细节织成的织物
senses.example: The cello's low notes give the passage a dark texture.
senses.exampleCN: 大提琴的低音给这段音乐一种暗沉的质感。
senses.why: A voice or a page also has grain: details are woven together, and the ear or reader judges the weave rather than any single thread.
senses.whyCN: 嗓音或书页也有颗粒：细节被织在一起，耳朵或读者评判的是织法，而非某一根线。

senses.title: The interweaving of parts in music
senses.definition: in music, the way voices or instrumental parts are combined and layered across a piece
senses.definitionCN: 音乐中各个嗓音或器乐声部在一首作品里结合与分层的方式
senses.example: The composer thins the texture in the second movement.
senses.exampleCN: 作曲家在第二乐章把织体减薄。
senses.why: Music theory borrows the weaving image literally: separate lines cross and support each other like warp and weft.
senses.whyCN: 音乐理论直接借用了编织的意象：各条线像经线与纬线那样交错、彼此支撑。

senses.title: The grain and structure of a material
senses.titleCN: 材料的颗粒与内部结构
senses.definition: in geology and materials, the size, shape and arrangement of grains that make up a rock, soil or solid
senses.definitionCN: 地质学与材料学中构成岩石、土壤或固体的颗粒大小、形状与排列方式
senses.example: The soil's sandy texture lets water drain quickly.
senses.exampleCN: 这土壤的砂质结构让水很快排走。
senses.why: Science narrows the word to what can be measured: the grains and their arrangement replace the subjective feel.
senses.whyCN: 科学把词义收窄到可测量的部分：颗粒及其排列取代了主观手感。

senses.title: A mapped surface image in computer graphics
senses.titleCN: 计算机图形中贴到表面的图像
senses.definition: in computer graphics, an image wrapped over a three-dimensional surface to give it detail
senses.definitionCN: 计算机图形学中包覆在三维表面上、为其增加细节的图像
senses.example: The game renders a wood texture on every table in the room.
senses.exampleCN: 游戏给房间里的每张桌子渲染了木纹贴图。
senses.why: A digital surface needs the same information the hand once supplied, so an image is stretched over the model and called a texture.
senses.whyCN: 数字表面需要的信息与手曾经提供的一样，于是把一张图铺展到模型上，并称之为纹理。

intro.en: Texture comes from Latin textura 'weaving, fabric', a noun built on texere 'to weave'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: texture 来自拉丁语 textura「编织、织物」，由动词 texere「编织」构成的名词。年代均为约数。

items.en: Texere meant 'to weave, to plait, to construct'. Its deeper root is generally reconstructed as *teks- 'to weave, to make', which is a reconstruction rather than a recorded form.
items.cn: texere 意为「编织、编结、构造」。其更深的词根一般认为可重构为 *teks-「编织、制作」，这属于重构形式，而非实际书证。

items.en: The suffix -ura named the result of an action, so textura was 'a weaving, a fabric, a woven thing'.
items.cn: 后缀 -ura 表示动作的结果，因此 textura 指「编织、织物、织成之物」。

items.en: The same verb produced textus, 'something woven', which later gave English text; cloth and text share one image.
items.cn: 同一个动词还产生 textus「织成之物」，后来进入英语成为「文本」；布与文本共享同一个意象。

items.en: English took texture in the fifteenth century, generally through Old French, where it still named woven cloth.
items.cn: 英语在 15 世纪接受 texture，一般认为经由古法语传入，当时仍指织成的布。

items.en: By the seventeenth century the word had moved from cloth to any surface, and touch rather than the loom became the point of reference.
items.cn: 到 17 世纪，这个词已从布匹扩展到任何表面，参照点也从织机变成了触摸。

items.en: Source uncertain: whether the first English uses came straight from Latin or through French is not fully established; the French route is generally assumed.
items.cn: 来源不确定：英语最早的用法是直接取自拉丁语，还是经由法语，尚无定论；一般认为走的是法语路径。

note.en: The first group holds words that look close to texture and come from the same weaving verb but name different things; the second holds words about surface and material quality that differ in focus.
note.cn: 第一组是外形接近、同出编织动词但所指不同的词；第二组指表面与材料性质，在关注点上有别。

entries.definition: Written material; it comes from the same Latin verb texere 'to weave', since a text is a woven thing, but it names words rather than a surface.
entries.definitionCN: 文字材料；出自同一拉丁动词 texere「编织」，因为文本本是被织成之物，但它指文字而非表面。

entries.definition: Cloth or fabric, the original product that textura named; it stays with woven material and does not extend to feel in general.
entries.definitionCN: 布料或织物，正是 textura 最初所指的产物；它停留在编织材料，不扩展到一般手感。

entries.definition: Relating to written text; it belongs to text, not to the feel or grain of a surface.
entries.definitionCN: 与书面文本有关的；它属于 text，而不属于表面的手感或纹理。

entries.definition: The direction and size of fibres or particles in wood, stone or cloth; grain is one cause of texture, not the whole impression.
entries.definitionCN: 木材、石料或布中纤维与颗粒的方向和大小；颗粒只是质地的成因之一，并不等于整体印象。

entries.definition: The final treatment given to a surface, such as matte or gloss; finish names the treatment, texture names the result as felt.
entries.definitionCN: 表面最后的处理方式，如哑光或高光；finish 指处理，texture 指被感受到的结果。

entries.definition: The general impression a surface gives to the hand; a plainer word than texture and often used in speech.
entries.definitionCN: 表面对手给出的总体印象；比 texture 更朴素，多用于口语。

entries.definition: The firmness or thickness of a substance, especially food or paint; it describes body rather than surface detail.
entries.definitionCN: 物质的浓稠或坚实程度，尤用于食物或颜料；它描述的是稠度而非表面细节。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real Latin pieces, the real word family and the phrases the word actually keeps.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的拉丁构件、真实的同族词，以及这个词实际常用的搭配。

normal.en: Texere 'to weave' + -ura 'result' = the result of weaving, a fabric.
normal.cn: texere「编织」+ -ura「结果」= 编织的产物，也就是织物。

normal.en: Texture and textile are close relatives, both coming from the loom.
normal.cn: 「织体」与「纺织品」是近亲，都来自织机。

normal.en: The hand reads texture; the eye reads the same small pattern.
normal.cn: 手读质地，眼读的其实是同一小片纹样。

normal.en: A coarse cloth shows its texture as roughness, a fine one as even grain.
normal.cn: 粗布以粗糙显出其质地，细布则以匀净的颗粒显出质地。

normal.en: In graphics a texture is an image laid over a surface, like cloth over a table.
normal.cn: 在图形学里，纹理是铺在表面上的一张图，像把布盖在桌上。

abstract.en: Picture a single thread pulled out of a weave and laid across the page.
abstract.cn: 想象从织物里抽出一根线，横放在纸页上。

abstract.en: Picture fingertips as small readers that report the height of every bump.
abstract.cn: 想象指尖是小小的读者，逐一报告每个凸起的高度。

abstract.en: Picture a voice with grain, like cloth that is not flat.
abstract.cn: 想象一副带有颗粒的声音，像一块并不平顺的布。

examples.en: The old wooden table has a warm texture worn smooth by years of use.
examples.cn: 那张旧木桌有温润的质地，被多年使用磨得光滑。

examples.en: Add crushed nuts to the dessert for extra texture.
examples.cn: 在甜点里加入碎坚果，增添额外的口感。

examples.en: The novel's texture comes from many short scenes woven together.
examples.cn: 这部小说的肌理来自许多短场景交织在一起。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「贴死扯」——手指贴上去，用力扯一扯布面，粗糙还是顺滑立刻知道，这就是质地。texere 是「编织」，织出来的东西表面自有纹路。

root: 拉丁语 textura「编织、织物」来自动词 texere「编织」；textura 由 texere 加表示动作结果的后缀 -ura 构成。英语经古法语借入，词义由织物结构扩展到任何表面的手感与可见纹理，并进一步用于音乐织体、材料颗粒与数字贴图。texere 更早的词根属重构形式。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses start with the feel of a surface under the hand, then move to visible grain and the woven cloth that gave the word its name, to food and sound, to music and the grain of materials, and finally to the image mapped onto a digital surface.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从手触摸表面的感觉出发，转到可见纹理与给这个词命名的织物结构，再到食物与声音，再到音乐织体与材料颗粒，最后是贴到数字表面的图像。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: threads cross and rise, so a surface carries a small repeated relief that the hand and the eye can both read.
core.cn: 核心意象：线交叉、起伏，表面因此带着细小的重复凹凸，手与眼都能读出来。

branches.en: THE CORE TOUCH: texture is first what the hand learns about a surface, its roughness or smoothness.
branches.cn: 核心触感：质地首先是手从表面得知的东西，是粗糙还是光滑。

branches.en: SIGHT AND WEAVE: the word keeps the woven structure of cloth and the visible grain of any surface, two readings of the same small pattern.
branches.cn: 视觉与编织：这个词既保留布的编织结构，也指任何表面的可见纹理，两者是同一小片纹样的两种读法。

branches.en: MOUTH AND EAR: food is judged by the same grain under the teeth, and a voice or a page is read as a fabric of details.
branches.cn: 口与耳：食物靠牙齿下的同一份颗粒感被评判，嗓音或书页则被读成由细节织成的布。

branches.en: THE WEAVE WIDENS: music combines lines like warp and weft, while geology measures the grains that make up a solid.
branches.cn: 织法变宽：音乐像经纬那样把线条结合起来，地质学则测量构成固体的颗粒。

branches.en: THE IMAGE ON THE SURFACE: a digital model receives a picture stretched over it, so the surface detail is supplied as an image.
branches.cn: 表面上的图像：数字模型被铺上一张图，表面细节于是以图像的方式供给。

intro.en: Texture can be read as a Latin verb, a Latin noun suffix and a Latin noun, with a small English adjective family built on top.
intro.cn: texture 可以读作一个拉丁动词、一个拉丁名词后缀和一个拉丁名词，再加上一小族英语形容词派生词。

latinIntro.en: Latin texere 'to weave' with -ura 'result' produced textura 'fabric'; English borrowed it and later added -al and -ed for the adjectives.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 texere「编织」加 -ura「结果」构成 textura「织物」；英语借入后，又加两个形容词词尾构成形容词。

items.structure: texere, texui, textum (Latin verb, third conjugation)
items.meaning: to weave, to plait, to construct
items.example: The verb supplies the action behind the whole family.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词提供整个词族的动作来源。

items.meaning: the result or product of an action
items.example: The suffix turns the act of weaving into the thing woven.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把编织的动作变成织成之物。

items.example: Latin used the noun for cloth and for the way it was woven.
items.exampleCN: 拉丁语用这个名词指布，也指它的织法。

items.meaning: the feel or grain of a surface; to give a surface such a quality
items.meaningCN: 表面的手感或纹理；使表面具有这种性质
items.example: English widened the noun from cloth to every surface.
items.exampleCN: 英语把这个名词从布匹扩展到一切表面。

items.example: The suffix turns the noun of texture into an adjective.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把表示质地的名词变成形容词。

items.example: Critics praise the textural richness of the painting.
items.exampleCN: 评论家称赞这幅画丰富的肌理。

items.example: The suffix turns a noun into an adjective of possession.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把名词变成表示拥有的形容词。

items.example: The walls are textured with coarse plaster.
items.exampleCN: 墙面用粗灰泥做出了纹理。

derivatives.meaning: the noun of surface quality shifts to an adjective describing what belongs to texture
derivatives.meaningCN: 由表示表面性质的名词转为描述「属于质地」的形容词

derivatives.meaning: the noun shifts to an adjective meaning 'provided with a texture'
derivatives.meaningCN: 由名词转为形容词，表示「带有某种质地」

definition_zh: 解冻；融化；（关系）缓和；解冻期
definition_en: to melt after being frozen, or a period of warmer weather that melts ice and snow
core_image: 河面的冰裂开一道缝，露出下面黑亮的水，冰沿慢慢后退
scene: 午后阳光照在河面上，冰开始裂开融化。The ice on the river began to thaw in the afternoon sun.
sceneCN: 这里该词指「冰冻之物开始融化」（第 1 个义项：冰或雪解冻）；句意为河上的冰在午后阳光下开始融化。

pos.zh: 解冻；融化；（关系、态度）缓和
使解冻；使融化
解冻期；融化状态

senses.title: Ice or snow melts
senses.definition: to become liquid again after being frozen
senses.definitionCN: 冻结之后重新变成液体
senses.example: The ice on the river began to thaw in the afternoon sun.
senses.exampleCN: 河上的冰在午后阳光下开始融化。
senses.why: Thaw is the opposite of freeze, and it names the return of water from a locked solid to a moving liquid.
senses.whyCN: thaw 是 freeze 的反面，命名水从锁住的固体回到流动液体的过程。

senses.title: A warm spell
senses.definition: a period of weather warm enough to melt snow and ice
senses.definitionCN: 暖到能融化冰雪的一段天气
senses.example: A January thaw turned the lanes to mud.
senses.exampleCN: 一月的一次回暖把小路变成了泥浆。
senses.why: When the melting lasts for days, the process becomes a named season within winter.
senses.whyCN: 当融化持续数日，这个过程就成了冬天里有名字的一段时节。

senses.title: The melted state
senses.definition: the condition of having been melted, as in food that is no longer frozen
senses.definitionCN: 已经融化的状态，如不再冰冻的食物
senses.example: The meat is in thaw and should be cooked today.
senses.exampleCN: 肉已经解冻，今天该做掉。
senses.why: A noun use records the result rather than the action, useful when the change is already complete.
senses.whyCN: 名词用法记录结果而非动作，在变化已经完成时很有用。

senses.title: Relations become friendlier
senses.definition: of relations or attitudes, to become less hostile and more open
senses.definitionCN: 指关系或态度变得不那么敌对、更加开放
senses.example: Relations between the two neighbours thawed after the meeting.
senses.exampleCN: 会面之后，两家的关系缓和了。
senses.why: Frozen relations are rigid and silent; warmth lets them move again, so the ice image becomes diplomacy.
senses.whyCN: 冻结的关系僵硬而沉默；暖意让它们重新流动，于是冰的意象变成了外交。

senses.title: Defrost frozen food
senses.definition: to let frozen food stand until it is no longer hard
senses.definitionCN: 让冷冻食物放置到不再坚硬
senses.example: Thaw the fish overnight in the fridge.
senses.exampleCN: 把鱼放在冰箱里解冻一夜。
senses.why: Food follows the physical rule: heat flows in, ice turns to water, and the solid becomes usable.
senses.whyCN: 食物遵循同样的物理规律：热量流入，冰变成水，固体变得可用。

senses.title: Rules or policies soften
senses.definition: of rules or policies, to become less strict
senses.definitionCN: 指规定或政策变得不那么严格
senses.example: The new government thawed the restrictions on travel.
senses.exampleCN: 新政府放宽了旅行限制。
senses.why: A frozen rule cannot bend; a thawed one can, so the metaphor covers political liberalization.
senses.whyCN: 冻结的规则不能弯；解冻后的可以，所以这个比喻覆盖政治上的放宽。

senses.title: Permafrost melting
senses.definition: the melting of permanently frozen ground in polar regions
senses.definitionCN: 极地地区常年冻结地面的融化
senses.example: Permafrost thaw is collapsing the Arctic roads.
senses.exampleCN: 永久冻土融化正在使北极的道路塌陷。
senses.why: In climate science the subject is ground rather than ice on water, but the change of state is the same.
senses.whyCN: 在气候科学中，主体是土地而不是水面上的冰，但状态变化相同。

senses.title: A person warms up
senses.definition: of a person, to become warm again after being very cold
senses.definitionCN: 指人在极冷之后重新暖和起来
senses.example: She thawed out by the fire with a mug of tea.
senses.exampleCN: 她在炉边捧着一杯茶暖和过来。
senses.why: The body is the frozen object here, and the word describes circulation returning.
senses.whyCN: 这里被冻住的对象是身体，这个词描述血液循环恢复。

intro.en: Thaw is a native Germanic verb. Its link to the PIE root for melting is generally accepted, though the exact root shape is reconstructed.
intro.cn: thaw 是日耳曼本土动词。它与原始印欧语「融化」词根的联系一般被接受，但确切词根形状属重构。

items.en: Old English þawian meant 'to thaw', and the noun þaw 'thawing' also existed.
items.cn: 古英语 þawian 意为「解冻」，名词 þaw「解冻」也已存在。

items.en: The verb is reconstructed as *thawon, with Dutch dooien and German tauen as close relatives.
items.cn: 该动词被重构为 *thawon，荷兰语 dooien 与德语 tauen 是近亲。

items.en: It is generally connected with PIE *tā- 'to melt', the source of Latin tabes 'melting, decay' and tabidus 'wasting away'.
items.cn: 它一般被联系到原始印欧语 *tā-「融化」，拉丁语 tabes「融化、衰败」与 tabidus「消耗的」即出自此。

items.en: Middle English thawen kept the physical sense and began to be used for frozen food as well as for ice.
items.cn: 中古英语 thawen 保留物理义，并开始既用于冰也用于冷冻食物。

items.en: The figurative 'thaw in relations' is recorded in the nineteenth century, and climate science later applied the word to permafrost.
items.cn: 比喻性的「关系缓和」在十九世纪有记录，气候科学后来又把该词用到永久冻土上。

note.en: Group one holds short words that look or sound close to thaw; group two holds other words for ice turning to water.
note.cn: 第一组是与 thaw 字形或读音接近的短词；第二组是表示冰化成水的其他词。

entries.definition: An old form of you; the vowel is a diphthong /aʊ/ and the meaning is unrelated.
entries.definitionCN: 古体的「你」；元音是双元音 /aʊ/，意义无关。

entries.definition: A sharp spine on a plant; it shares the first sound but ends in -rn.
entries.definitionCN: 植物上的尖刺；它共享开头音，但词尾是 -rn。

entries.definition: An idea, or the past of think; the vowel is similar but the final cluster is -ght.
entries.definitionCN: 想法，或 think 的过去式；元音相近，但词尾是 -ght。

entries.definition: To become liquid by heat; it works for ice, butter and metal, while thaw usually implies something was frozen.
entries.definitionCN: 受热变成液体；可用于冰、黄油与金属，而 thaw 通常暗示原先被冻住。

entries.definition: To remove ice from a freezer or windscreen; it is a purposeful action, not merely a rise in temperature.
entries.definitionCN: 清除冷冻柜或挡风玻璃上的冰；它是有意为之的动作，而不只是温度上升。

entries.definition: To make less hard or less severe; it is the general word behind figurative 'relations thaw'.
entries.definitionCN: 使变软或使缓和；它是比喻性「关系解冻」背后的通用词。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real verb forms and real climate terms.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的动词形式与真实气候术语。

normal.en: thaw is the direct opposite of freeze; a frozen pond thaws when warm air arrives.
normal.cn: thaw 是 freeze 的直接反面；暖空气到来时，冻住的池塘就会 thaw。

normal.en: thaw out is the phrasal form used for people and pipes: warmth returns to something that was stiff with cold.
normal.cn: thaw out 是用于人和管道的短语形式：暖意回到被冻僵的东西上。

normal.en: spring thaw is the standard phrase for the seasonal melt that floods rivers.
normal.cn: spring thaw 是描述季节性融雪、使河水上涨的标准说法。

normal.en: permafrost thaw pairs the verb with the ground that never used to melt.
normal.cn: permafrost thaw 把这个动词与原本从不融化的土地配在一起。

normal.en: a thaw in relations uses the ice image for politics, just as a freeze in talks uses the opposite image.
normal.cn: a thaw in relations 把冰的意象用于政治，正如 a freeze in talks 用相反的意象。

abstract.en: Abstractly, thaw is the return of movement: what was locked becomes liquid and can flow again.
abstract.cn: 抽象地看，thaw 是运动的回归：被锁住的东西变成液体，重新可以流动。

abstract.en: The same return can happen to ice, to frozen food, to permafrost, to a frozen relationship or to frozen rules.
abstract.cn: 同样的回归可以发生在冰、冷冻食物、永久冻土、冻结的关系或冻结的规则上。

abstract.en: So thaw always implies a previous cold state and a new permission to move.
abstract.cn: 所以 thaw 总暗示先前的寒冷状态，以及新的「可以活动」的许可。

examples.en: The river thawed earlier than usual this year.
examples.cn: 今年这条河比往年更早解冻。

examples.en: Leave the frozen peas to thaw on the counter.
examples.cn: 把冻豌豆放在台面上解冻。

examples.en: Talks resumed after a slight thaw between the two sides.
examples.cn: 双方关系略有缓和后，谈判重新开始。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「套」：冰套子融开了 → thaw 解冻

root: 古英语 þawian「解冻」，出自原始日耳曼语 *thawon，更早一般联系到原始印欧语 *tā-「融化」，与拉丁语 tabes「融化、衰败」同源；确切词根形状属重构。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow ice giving way: the melt, the warm spell, the melted state, friendlier relations, thawed food, looser rules, melting permafrost and a person warming up.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿着「冰让位」展开：融化、回暖期、融化状态、关系缓和、食物解冻、规定松动、冻土融化，以及人暖和过来。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a locked solid opens and lets water move again.
core.cn: 核心意象：锁住的固体松开，让水重新流动。

branches.en: THE MELTED STATE: the same event seen after it ends.
branches.cn: 融化后的状态：同一事件结束后的样子。

branches.en: SCALE: a winter warm spell and a melting Arctic both measure the same change over time.
branches.cn: 尺度：冬季回暖与北极融化都在时间尺度上度量同一种变化。

branches.en: WARMTH ARRIVES: food and a cold person both wait for heat to enter.
branches.cn: 暖意到来：食物与受冻的人都在等待热量进入。

branches.en: SOCIAL THAW: relations and rules become less frozen and more movable.
branches.cn: 社会解冻：关系与规则不再那么冻结，变得更可松动。

branches.en: PHYSICAL BASE: all the other senses borrow the melting of ice.
branches.cn: 物理基础：其余所有义项都借用了冰的融化。

intro.en: Thaw is a small Germanic family; most of its extensions are phrasal verbs and fixed weather compounds rather than suffixes.
intro.cn: thaw 是一个小的日耳曼词族；其扩展多为短语动词与固定天气复合词，而非后缀派生。

latinIntro.en: The Latin entries below are cognates from PIE *tā-, not ancestors. Latin tabes 'melting, decay' shows the same root without the ice.
latinIntro.cn: 下面的拉丁条目是出自原始印欧语 *tā- 的同源词，而非祖先。拉丁语 tabes「融化、衰败」显示同一词根，只是不带冰。

items.meaningCN: 融化的过程（-ing 构成动名词）
items.example: Thawing releases water into the soil.
items.exampleCN: 融化把水释放到土壤里。

items.meaningCN: 已解冻的（-ed 构成过去分词）
items.example: Use the thawed berries today.
items.exampleCN: 今天就用解冻的浆果。

items.meaning: to warm up after being very cold
items.meaningCN: 在极冷之后暖和过来（out 表示「出来」）
items.example: We thawed out beside the stove.
items.exampleCN: 我们在炉子边暖和过来。

items.meaning: the seasonal melt at the end of winter
items.example: The spring thaw floods the low fields.
items.exampleCN: 春季融雪淹了低洼的田地。

items.meaning: the melting of permanently frozen ground
items.example: Permafrost thaw undermines the pipeline.
items.exampleCN: 永久冻土融化正在削弱管道基础。

items.meaning: the part of the year when ice melts
items.meaningCN: 一年中冰雪融化的时段
items.example: Travel is restricted during the thaw season.
items.exampleCN: 解冻季节限制通行。

items.meaning: a pond formed by melting ground ice
items.meaningCN: 地下冰融化形成的水塘
items.example: The thaw lake grew wider each summer.
items.exampleCN: 这个融冻湖每个夏天都变宽。

items.example: Thaw water filled the ditches.
items.exampleCN: 融水灌满了沟渠。

definition_zh: 剧院；戏院；戏剧；手术室（英式旧用）
definition_en: a building for watching plays, the writing and performance of plays as an art, or a place where major events unfold
core_image: 大幕拉开：一屋子人在黑暗里同看台上一方被灯照亮的小世界
scene: 剧院侧门人流涌出，她攥着刚买到的票。The theatre was packed before the curtain went up.
sceneCN: 这里 theatre 是「剧院」（第 1 个义项：观演戏剧的建筑）；句意：大幕未启，剧院已座无虚席。

pos.zh: 剧院；戏院；戏剧（艺术）；战场；手术室（英式旧用）

derivatives.zh: 戏剧的；夸张做作的（theatre 加形容词后缀 -ical 构成）
戏剧性地；做作地（theatrical 加副词后缀）
戏剧演出；业余演戏（复数名词）
圆形露天剧场（amphi- 表「两侧」加 theatre，指环形观看）

senses.title: A building for watching plays
senses.definition: a building or outdoor area where plays and performances are given to an audience
senses.definitionCN: 供观众观看戏剧与演出的建筑或露天场所
senses.example: The oldest theatre in the city dates from the eighteen twenties.
senses.exampleCN: 城里最古老的剧院建于十九世纪二十年代。
senses.why: The word first names the place where watching happens: rows of seats facing a lit stage.
senses.whyCN: 这个词先指「观看发生之地」：一排排座椅面向亮灯的舞台。

senses.title: The art of writing and acting plays
senses.definition: the art or profession of writing and performing plays
senses.definitionCN: 创作与表演戏剧的艺术或行业
senses.example: She has worked in the theatre for twenty years.
senses.exampleCN: 她从事戏剧工作已有二十年。
senses.why: The place lends its name to the activity that fills it, then to the whole art.
senses.whyCN: 场地的名字转给充满它的活动，再转给整门艺术。

senses.title: A scene of important events
senses.definition: a place where important events happen, used figuratively, as in the theatre of war
senses.definitionCN: 重大事件发生之地，比喻用法，如战区
senses.example: Eastern Europe became the main theatre of the conflict.
senses.exampleCN: 东欧成为这场冲突的主要战区。
senses.why: History borrows the stage: wherever the great scene is played becomes a theatre.
senses.whyCN: 历史借走舞台：大戏在哪里上演，哪里就是 theatre。

senses.title: An operating room
senses.definition: a room in a hospital where operations are performed, in British usage
senses.definitionCN: 英式英语中指医院施行手术的房间
senses.example: The patient was moved into theatre within minutes.
senses.exampleCN: 病人几分钟内就被推进了手术室。
senses.why: The surgeon works under lights before watchers, like a stage performance turned inward.
senses.whyCN: 外科医生在灯下、在注视中工作，像一场向内翻转的舞台演出。

intro.en: Theatre comes from Greek theatron, a place for seeing, from theasthai, to behold. The Greeks built the word before they built the stone seats.
intro.cn: theatre 出自希腊语 theatron「观看之所」，词根 theasthai 意为观看。希腊人先造出这个词，才造出石砌的座位。

items.en: Theasthai meant to look at, to gaze upon, and theatron named the seeing place of the hillside audience.
items.cn: theasthai 意为注视、凝望；theatron 命名山坡上观众的「看台」。

items.en: The root also gave theory, a beholding of truth rather than of plays; watching is the shared image.
items.cn: 同一词根还给出 theory「理论」——凝视真理而非戏剧；「观看」是共同意象。

items.en: Latin borrowed theatron as theatrum, keeping both the building and the figurative stage of affairs.
items.cn: 拉丁语把 theatron 借作 theatrum，兼指建筑与比喻性的事件舞台。

items.en: French theatre carried the word into medieval English texts about ancient spectacles.
items.cn: 法语 theatre 把这个词带进中世纪英语谈古代奇观的文章。

items.en: English took theatre in the fourteenth century; the playhouse sense grew with real playhouses.
items.cn: 英语于十四世纪借入 theatre；剧场义随真实剧场的出现而生长。

items.en: Modern English added the art sense, the theatre of war, and the British operating theatre.
items.cn: 现代英语添加了艺术义、战区义与英式手术室义。

note.en: The first group follows the seeing root into neighbouring words; the second separates the watching places.
note.cn: 第一组沿「观看」词根走进邻近词；第二组区分各种观看场所。

entries.definition: a beholding of truth; the same Greek seeing root pointed at ideas instead of plays
entries.definitionCN: 理论；同一希腊「观看」词根指向了观念而非戏剧

entries.definition: of the theatre; also exaggerated and showy in manner
entries.definitionCN: 戏剧的；亦指举止夸张做作

entries.definition: the study of God; shares the th- look but the root is different
entries.definitionCN: 神学；字形相近但词根不同

entries.definition: a building for films rather than live performance
entries.definitionCN: 电影院；放映电影而非现场演出

entries.definition: the platform itself, or the acting profession; narrower than theatre
entries.definitionCN: 舞台本身或演艺行业；比 theatre 窄

entries.definition: the listening hall; names the audience space inside any venue
entries.definitionCN: 礼堂；指场馆内的观众空间

normalIntro.en: Real links: the Greek seeing root, theory from the same root, the operating theatre, and the theatre of war.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：希腊「观看」词根、同根的 theory、手术室、以及战区。

normal.en: Theatron means a place for seeing; the seats exist for the gaze.
normal.cn: theatron 意为观看之所；座位为目光而设。

normal.en: Theory and theatre share one root: watching truth and watching plays.
normal.cn: theory 与 theatre 同根：凝视真理与观看戏剧。

normal.en: An operating theatre turns the stage lights onto the patient.
normal.cn: operating theatre 把舞台灯转向病人。

normal.en: The theatre of war is where history plays its largest scenes.
normal.cn: theatre of war 是历史演出最大场面的地方。

normal.en: Theatrical praise sounds like acting: too many gestures.
normal.cn: theatrical 的赞美听起来像演戏：手势太多。

abstract.en: Every theatre is an agreement to watch together in the dark.
abstract.cn: 每座剧场都是一场「在黑暗中共同观看」的约定。

abstract.en: History needs a stage before it needs a script.
abstract.cn: 历史需要舞台，然后才需要剧本。

abstract.en: Seeing is the oldest art: the Greeks built a word for it first.
abstract.cn: 观看是最古老的艺术：希腊人先给它造了词。

examples.en: We booked two seats at the National Theatre.
examples.cn: 我们在国家剧院订了两个座位。

examples.en: Theatre in this city survived the fire and the plague.
examples.cn: 这座城市的戏剧挺过了大火与瘟疫。

examples.en: The Pacific became the central theatre of the naval war.
examples.cn: 太平洋成为海战的主战区。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「西厄特」——想坐「好席位」特不容易，得早起去剧场 → theatre 剧院

root: 希腊语 theasthai「观看」→ theatron「观看之所」→ 拉丁语 theatrum → 古法语 theatre → 英语；同根词 theory。

sensesIntro.en: From the Greek seeing-place, theatre grows into the playhouse, the art performed inside it, the figurative stage of war, and the surgeon's lit room.
sensesIntro.cn: 从希腊的观看之所出发，theatre 长成剧场、场内的戏剧艺术、比喻性的战区舞台，以及外科医生灯下的房间。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a lit stage ringed by watching eyes in the dark.
core.cn: 核心意象：黑暗中被众多目光环绕的亮灯舞台。

branches.en: The building exists for the gaze.
branches.cn: 建筑为目光而存在。

branches.en: The place names the art that fills it.
branches.cn: 场地把名字借给充满它的艺术。

branches.en: Big events borrow the stage for themselves.
branches.cn: 大事件把舞台据为己用。

branches.en: The surgeon works watched under lights.
branches.cn: 外科医生在灯下被注视着工作。

branches.en: Building and art share one seeing root.
branches.cn: 建筑与艺术共享同一观看词根。

intro.en: Theatre builds with the adjective suffix -ical, the adverb -ly, and the prefix amphi- for the all-round viewing ring.
intro.cn: theatre 用形容词后缀 -ical、副词 -ly，以及表「环视」的前缀 amphi- 构词。

latinIntro.en: Latin theatrum is the direct channel from Greek; the seeing root also reached English through theory and its family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 theatrum 是希腊词的直接通道；观看词根还经 theory 一族抵达英语。

items.example: His theatrical sighs fooled no one.
items.exampleCN: 他夸张的叹气谁也骗不了。

items.meaning: in a dramatic or exaggerated way
items.example: She threw her arms up theatrically.
items.exampleCN: 她夸张地张开双臂。

items.meaning: a round arena with seats all around
items.example: Gladiators fought in the amphitheatre.
items.exampleCN: 角斗士在圆形剧场里搏斗。

items.example: The operating theatre was sterilised hourly.
items.exampleCN: 手术室每小时消毒一次。

items.meaning: a person who attends plays regularly
items.example: Theatre-goers queued round the block.
items.exampleCN: 戏迷们排到了街区尽头。

items.meaning: a stage surrounded by the audience on all sides
items.meaningCN: 中心式舞台；四面观众的舞台
items.example: The troupe performs theatre in the round.
items.exampleCN: 剧团采用四面舞台演出。

items.meaning: the quality of being showy or dramatic
items.example: His theatricality tired the audience.
items.exampleCN: 他的做作让观众疲惫。

items.meaning: a combined film and stage venue
items.example: The old cinema theatre still holds concerts.
items.exampleCN: 老影剧院仍在举办音乐会。

latinEntries.meaning: a place for seeing; a playhouse

definition_zh: 理论的；理论上的；假设的；以理论推理为依据的
definition_en: based on general principles and reasoning rather than on practice, observation or direct experiment
core_image: 黑板上推演到一半的公式，与现实车间里尚未造出的机器隔着一段距离
scene: 理论组把公式钉满白板，实验组在旁摇头。Theoretical physics often runs decades ahead of experiment.
sceneCN: 这里 theoretical 指「理论的」（第 1 个义项：依据原理与推理、而非实践与实验）；句意：理论物理学往往比实验领先数十年。图中可辨识物件：写满推演的黑板、尚未装配的仪器草图。

pos.zh: 理论的；理论上的；假设的（与 practical、experimental、applied 相对）

derivatives.zh: 理论的（多见于 theoretic framework 等学术搭配）
定理（与 theory 同出希腊 theōrēma「所观之物」）

senses.title: Based on Theory
senses.titleCN: 理论的：依据原理而非实践
senses.definition: based on ideas and general principles rather than on practice or experiment
senses.definitionCN: 依据观念与一般原理，而非实践或实验的
senses.example: Theoretical physics often runs decades ahead of experiment.
senses.exampleCN: 理论物理学往往比实验领先数十年。
senses.why: Greek theoria named looking and contemplating. The adjective marks knowledge reached by reasoning about principles, not by handling the thing itself.
senses.whyCN: 希腊 theoria 指观看与沉思。这个形容词标出的是通过对原理的推理而获得的知识，而不是亲手处理事物得来的知识。

senses.title: Hypothetical
senses.titleCN: 假设的：只为推理而设想
senses.definition: imagined or supposed for the purpose of reasoning, not actual
senses.definitionCN: 为推理而设想或假定，并非实际存在
senses.example: Let us take a theoretical case in which nobody pays tax.
senses.exampleCN: 让我们设想一个没人缴税的理论情形。
senses.why: A case built to test an argument is not observed anywhere. It exists only inside the reasoning, so the adjective shifts from 'about theory' to 'merely supposed'.
senses.whyCN: 为检验论证而构造的情形并不在任何地方被观察到，它只存在于推理之中；于是这个形容词从「关于理论的」滑向「仅仅假设的」。

senses.title: Predicted but Unseen
senses.titleCN: 理论预言的：尚未观测到
senses.definition: predicted by theory but not yet observed
senses.definitionCN: 由理论预言、但尚未被观测到的
senses.example: The theoretical particle would leave only a tiny trace in the detector.
senses.exampleCN: 这种理论粒子只会在探测器中留下极微小的痕迹。
senses.why: Theory can name something before any instrument sees it. The adjective marks that priority of reasoning over observation, which is common in particle physics.
senses.whyCN: 理论可以在任何仪器看见某物之前先给它命名；这个形容词标出的正是推理先于观测，这在粒子物理中很常见。

senses.title: Of the Theory Branch
senses.titleCN: 理论分支的：学科的理论侧
senses.definition: belonging to the branch of a subject that studies principles rather than applications
senses.definitionCN: 属于研究原理而非应用的那个学科分支
senses.example: She holds a chair in theoretical computer science.
senses.exampleCN: 她担任理论计算机科学方向的教授。
senses.why: Disciplines split into theory and application. The adjective labels the theory side, where the aim is to prove what is possible, not to ship a product.
senses.whyCN: 学科会分成理论与应用两侧；这个形容词标出理论一侧，其目标是证明什么在原理上可行，而不是交付产品。

senses.title: Idealized Model
senses.titleCN: 理想化模型的：删去复杂细节
senses.definition: belonging to an idealized model that leaves out complicating details
senses.definitionCN: 属于省略了复杂细节的理想化模型
senses.example: The theoretical model assumes a perfectly smooth sphere.
senses.exampleCN: 这个理论模型假定球体完全光滑。
senses.why: A model is made by leaving things out. The word marks that the object is a construction, so its predictions hold only as far as the omissions are harmless.
senses.whyCN: 模型是靠删减造出来的；这个词标出该对象是一种构造物，因此其预测只在删减无碍的范围内成立。

senses.title: Possible in Principle
senses.titleCN: 原则上可能的：逻辑容许
senses.definition: possible according to reasoning, whether or not it can be done in practice
senses.definitionCN: 按推理是可能的，不论实践中能否做到
senses.example: A theoretical solution exists, but nobody can build it yet.
senses.exampleCN: 理论上存在解法，但暂时没人能把它造出来。
senses.why: If the reasoning permits something, it is theoretically possible. The barrier lies in materials or cost, not in logic, which is why the two words 'theoretical' and 'practical' so often face each other.
senses.whyCN: 如果推理容许某件事，它就是理论上可能的；障碍在材料或成本，而不在逻辑，所以 theoretical 与 practical 常常成对出现。

senses.title: Abstract, Not Applied
senses.titleCN: 抽象的：带不务实的意味
senses.definition: concerned with abstract reasoning, often with a hint of impracticality
senses.definitionCN: 关心抽象推理，常暗示不切实际
senses.example: His answer was theoretical and ignored the cost of the plan.
senses.exampleCN: 他的回答是理论性的，忽略了该计划的成本。
senses.why: When reasoning ignores real conditions, the same word turns mildly critical: correct in the abstract and useless in this room. The tone comes from context, not from the root.
senses.whyCN: 当推理无视现实条件，同一个词就带上轻微批评：抽象上正确，在这间屋子里却没用。这一语气来自语境，而非词根。

senses.title: Consistent within a Theory
senses.titleCN: 理论体系内的：内部自洽
senses.definition: consistent with the definitions and assumptions of a given theory
senses.definitionCN: 与某一理论的定义和假定保持一致
senses.example: The objection is theoretical: the two claims cannot both hold.
senses.exampleCN: 这一反对是理论层面的：两项主张不能同时成立。
senses.why: Inside a theory, statements must fit its own rules. A theoretical objection attacks that fit rather than the data, so it can be settled by argument alone.
senses.whyCN: 在一个理论内部，陈述必须符合它自己的规则；理论性反对攻击的正是这种吻合，而不是数据，因此仅凭论证就能解决。

intro.en: Theoretical descends from Greek theōria 'a looking, contemplation', through Latin theoreticus. The Greek noun is usually traced to theoros 'spectator', but the details of the earliest formation are debated.
intro.cn: theoretical 经拉丁 theoreticus 上溯希腊 theōria「观看、沉思」。这个希腊名词通常追溯到 theoros「观看者」，但最早构词细节仍有争议。

items.en: The noun thea is generally taken to mean 'a view, a sight', and horan means 'to see'. Together they are thought to give theoros, 'one who looks on', especially a spectator at a festival or an envoy consulting an oracle.
items.cn: 名词 thea 一般认为是「景象、观看」，horan 意为「看见」；两者合成 theoros，即「观看的人」，尤指节庆上的观众或去求神谕的使者。此说一般认为是，细节并不完全确定。

items.en: From theoros came the noun theōria, 'the act of looking on, contemplation, a spectacle'. Philosophy borrowed it for the mind's disinterested viewing of truth, away from action.
items.cn: 由 theoros 产生名词 theōria，意为「观看的行为、沉思、景象」。哲学借它指心灵不带功利地观看真理，与行动保持距离。

items.en: Latin took the adjective theorēticus from Greek theoretikos, 'of contemplation'. The Latin form kept the philosophical sense of knowledge pursued for understanding rather than for use.
items.cn: 拉丁语从希腊 theoretikos 借入形容词 theorēticus，意为「沉思的」。拉丁形式保留了哲学含义：为理解而非为实用而追求的知识。

items.en: English theoretical appears in the seventeenth century beside the older theoretic. The -al form became the everyday adjective, while theoretic survived mainly in fixed academic phrases. The first citation is uncertain.
items.cn: 英语 theoretical 于十七世纪出现，与更早的 theoretic 并存。-al 形式成为日常形容词，theoretic 主要残留在固定的学术搭配中。确切首见书证不确定。

items.en: The modern contrast between theoretical and practical is older than English: Greek already opposed theōria to praxis. The pair therefore marks a division of labour, not a judgement that one side is useless.
items.cn: 现代 theoretical 与 practical 的对立比英语更古老：希腊语已用 theōria 对 praxis。因此这一对词标出的是分工，而不是判定某一侧无用。

note.en: The first group traces one Greek family whose members are easily confused. The second holds near-synonyms that sit at different distances from reality.
note.cn: 第一组梳理同一个希腊词族中容易混淆的成员；第二组是距现实远近不同的近义词。

entries.definition: A body of principles that explains a field. It is the thing a theoretical argument is built inside, not the adjective describing the argument.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，指解释某一领域的一套原理；理论论证是在它内部进行的，而它不是描述论证的形容词。

entries.definition: A person who builds or studies theory. It names the human agent, so it never replaces theoretical before a noun.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，指建构或研究理论的人；它命名的是人，因此不能替代名词前的 theoretical。

entries.definition: An older adjective of the same meaning, now mostly confined to phrases such as theoretic framework. It is not a different concept.
entries.definitionCN: 同义的较旧形容词形式，如今多限于 theoretic framework 一类搭配；它并非另一个概念。

entries.definition: Imagined as a premise. It stresses that the case is not real, while theoretical may still describe a well-founded body of reasoning.
entries.definitionCN: 作为前提被设想出来的；强调情形不真实，而 theoretical 仍可指有根据的推理体系。

entries.definition: Concerning concepts or mental categories. It says the work happens with ideas, not that it is unproven.
entries.definitionCN: 关于概念或心智范畴的；它说的是工作以观念为材料，并不表示未经证实。

entries.definition: General and detached from concrete cases. It can be neutral or critical, but it does not imply a formal theory.
entries.definitionCN: 一般性的、脱离具体个案的；可中性也可带批评，但不暗示存在形式化的理论。

entries.definition: Based on conjecture with little evidence. It is more negative than theoretical, which can be rigorous.
entries.definitionCN: 基于猜测而证据不足的；比 theoretical 更负面，因为 theoretical 可以是严谨的。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: theoria 'a looking' + -al: knowledge from viewing principles with the mind.
normal.cn: theoria「观看」+ -al：用心灵观看原理而得到的知识。

normal.en: The family runs theory, theorist, theorize, theoretic, theoretical, theorem.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 theory、theorist、theorize、theoretic、theoretical、theorem。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the use: theoretical framework, theoretical physics, theoretical model, theoretical possibility.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出用法：理论框架、理论物理学、理论模型、理论上的可能性。

normal.en: The opposite pair is theoretical and practical, or theoretical and experimental.
normal.cn: 对立搭配是 theoretical 与 practical，或 theoretical 与 experimental。

normal.en: theorem is a proved statement; theory is the whole system that contains it.
normal.cn: theorem 是被证明的命题；theory 是包含它的整个体系。

abstract.en: Picture a map drawn years before anyone walks the ground it describes.
abstract.cn: 想象一张地图，在任何人走过它所描述的地面之前许多年就已画好。

abstract.en: Picture a model ship in a bottle: exact in shape, unable to carry a single passenger.
abstract.cn: 想象瓶中船：形状精确，却载不了一位乘客。

abstract.en: Picture two people arguing about whether a door can open, without ever trying the handle.
abstract.cn: 想象两个人争论一扇门能不能开，却从不去拧门把手。

examples.en: The paper offers a theoretical explanation, but no experiment has tested it.
examples.cn: 这篇论文给出了一种理论解释，但尚无实验检验它。

examples.en: In theoretical terms the plan is sound; in practice it needs money nobody has.
examples.cn: 从理论上说这个计划是成立的；实践中它需要没人拿得出的资金。

examples.en: Students often find theoretical courses dry until they meet a real problem.
examples.cn: 学生常觉得理论课程枯燥，直到遇上一个真实问题。

dict_mnemonic.text: theory（理论）+ etical（形容词词尾）→ 属于理论的 → theoretical 理论的

root: 希腊 thea「景象」+ horan「看见」→ theoros「观看者」→ theōria「观看、沉思」→ 拉丁 theoreticus → 英语 theoretical。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses begin with reasoning rather than practice and fan out: a hypothetical case, an unobserved prediction, a branch of a discipline, an idealized model, a logical possibility, an abstract answer and an internal objection.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从「以推理而非实践为本」出发向外展开：假设情形、尚未观测的预言、学科分支、理想化模型、逻辑上的可能、抽象的回答与体系内部的反对。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a formula worked out on a board, separated from the machine it describes.
core.cn: 核心意象：黑板上推演出的公式，与它所描述的机器之间隔着距离。

branches.en: REASONING APART FROM PRACTICE: knowledge from principles, which can look either rigorous or useless depending on the room.
branches.cn: 与实践分离的推理：来自原理的知识，视场合可显得严谨，也可显得无用。

branches.en: THE SUPPOSED AND THE POSSIBLE: a case invented for argument and a solution the reasoning permits.
branches.cn: 假设与可能：为论证而虚构的情形，以及推理所容许的解法。

branches.en: THE UNSEEN: theory may name a particle before any detector records it.
branches.cn: 未见之物：理论可在任何探测器记录之前先为粒子命名。

branches.en: THE BRANCH: a discipline divides into a theory side and an application side.
branches.cn: 分支：一个学科分为理论侧与应用侧。

branches.en: CONSTRUCTION AND CONSISTENCY: a model built by omission must also stay coherent with its own assumptions.
branches.cn: 构造与自洽：靠省略建成的模型，还必须在自身假定内保持一致。

intro.en: Theoretical is a Greek noun of viewing turned into a Latin adjective and then an English one: root words for sight, a noun ending, and an adjective ending -al.
intro.cn: theoretical 是希腊语中表示「观看」的名词，先转为拉丁形容词，再进入英语：表示视觉的词根、名词词尾，以及形容词词尾 -al。

latinIntro.en: Greek theōria produced Latin theoreticus and English theory, theoretical, theorist, theorize and theorem. The same sight-root appears in theater, a place for viewing, though that word reached English by a different route.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊 theōria 产生拉丁 theoreticus，以及英语 theory、theoretical、theorist、theorize、theorem。同一个「观看」词根也出现在 theater（观看的场所）中，但那个词走的是另一条路径。

items.example: The theoretical part of the course comes first.
items.exampleCN: 课程的理论部分排在前面。

items.meaning: an organized body of explanatory principles
items.meaningCN: 有组织的解释性原理体系
items.example: The theory predicts a slow rise in sea level.
items.exampleCN: 该理论预测海平面会缓慢上升。

items.meaning: one who builds or studies theory
items.example: The theorist never visited the site she wrote about.
items.exampleCN: 这位理论家从未到过她所写的那处遗址。

items.meaning: to form or reason with theories
items.example: They theorized about the cause for years.
items.exampleCN: 他们多年来就成因进行理论推测。

items.meaningCN: theory 的较旧形容词形式
items.example: Theoretic work preceded any measurement.
items.exampleCN: 理论研究先于任何测量。

items.structure: theōrēma (a thing viewed, a proposition) + English form
items.example: The theorem holds for every triangle.
items.exampleCN: 该定理对一切三角形都成立。

items.meaning: of the stage; exaggerated as if acted
items.meaningCN: 戏剧的；如表演般夸张的
items.example: His grief was real but theatrical.
items.exampleCN: 他的悲伤是真的，却很戏剧化。

items.example: Theoretically, the bridge can hold twice that load.
items.exampleCN: 理论上，这座桥能承受两倍的荷载。

latinEntries.structure: theōria, -ae (f., first declension, Greek loan in Latin)

latinEntries.meaning: a spectacle; a proposition to be proved
latinEntries.meaningCN: 所见之物；待证明的命题

definition_zh: 理论；学说；原理；推测
definition_en: a systematic explanation of facts, a body of ideas about a subject, the principles behind a practice, or an unproven speculation
core_image: 一群人坐在看台上远远观看一场演出：先看见，再试图解释。
scene: 讲座散场，学生们还在争论黑板上的假说。In theory, the bridge should hold twice its own weight.
sceneCN: 这里 theory 是「理论上、按推算」（第 6 个义项：抽象推算而非实际）；句意：理论上，这座桥应能承受自身重量的两倍。场景要点：图纸上的受力箭头、计算器、尚未建成的桥。

pos.zh: 理论；学说；原理；推测

senses.title: A systematic scientific explanation
senses.titleCN: 科学理论：能解释事实的体系
senses.definition: a well-tested and widely accepted explanation of natural phenomena, supported by evidence
senses.definitionCN: 经充分检验、被广泛接受且有证据支持的自然现象解释
senses.example: The theory of plate tectonics explains why continents move.
senses.exampleCN: 板块构造理论解释了大陆为何移动。
senses.why: Greek theōria was a viewing, a act of watching. A scientific theory begins with careful observation, then builds the explanation that the watching supports.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 theōria 是“观看、观察”。科学理论从仔细观看开始，再建立观看所支持的说明。

senses.title: A body of ideas or doctrine
senses.titleCN: 学说：一个学派的一整套看法
senses.definition: a organized set of ideas or beliefs about a subject, often associated with a school or thinker
senses.definitionCN: 关于某一主题的有组织的一套观念或信念，常与某个学派或思想家相关
senses.example: He studied Marx's theory of history for his dissertation.
senses.exampleCN: 他为博士论文研究了马克思的历史学说。
senses.why: A single observation grows into a connected body of claims. The word then names the whole doctrine, not one explanation of one fact.
senses.whyCN: 单次观察长成一套相互关联的主张。这个词于是指整套学说，而不是对单一事实的解释。

senses.title: The principles behind a practice
senses.titleCN: 原理：一门技艺背后的道理
senses.definition: the general principles or rules underlying a practical art or skill
senses.definitionCN: 某一实践技艺背后的一般原理或规则
senses.example: She studied the theory of music before touching the piano.
senses.exampleCN: 她在碰钢琴之前先学了乐理。
senses.why: Watching a practice from above yields its rules. Theory here is the map of a craft, separated from the hand that performs it.
senses.whyCN: 从高处观看一门实践，就得到它的规则。这里的 theory 是一门手艺的地图，与实际操作的双手分离。

senses.title: A hypothesis offered as explanation
senses.definition: a proposed explanation that has not yet been proven or fully tested
senses.definitionCN: 尚未被证实或充分检验的提议性解释
senses.example: His theory is that the ship sank in a sudden storm.
senses.exampleCN: 他的假设是那艘船在突发的风暴中沉没。
senses.why: The same explanatory frame can be built before the evidence arrives. Then it is a hypothesis, but English still calls it a theory.
senses.whyCN: 同样的解释框架可以在证据到来之前先搭起来。这时它是假设，但英语仍称之为 theory。

senses.title: A speculative opinion
senses.definition: an opinion or conjecture based on limited evidence, often in everyday talk
senses.definitionCN: 基于有限证据的看法或猜想，常用于日常谈话
senses.example: My theory is that the cat knocked the vase off the shelf.
senses.exampleCN: 我的推测是猫把花瓶从架子上碰了下来。
senses.why: In ordinary speech, watching becomes guessing. The word loses its scientific weight and names any attempt to explain what happened.
senses.whyCN: 在日常口语里，观看变成了猜测。这个词失去科学分量，可以指任何对事情经过的解释尝试。

senses.title: In theory: as reasoned, not as practised
senses.titleCN: 理论上：推算成立，现实未必
senses.definition: used in the phrase in theory to mean according to reasoning or principle, as opposed to actual practice
senses.definitionCN: 用于 in theory，表示按推理或原理应当如此，与实际做法相对
senses.example: In theory, the system can process a million requests a second.
senses.exampleCN: 理论上，这个系统每秒能处理一百万次请求。
senses.why: Theory is what the spectator sees from the stand; practice is what happens on the field. The phrase sets the two viewpoints against each other.
senses.whyCN: theory 是看台上观众看到的，practice 是球场上实际发生的。这个短语把两个视角摆在对立面。

senses.title: Book learning as opposed to practice
senses.titleCN: 理论课：书本上的那一半
senses.definition: the part of a subject taught as principles and books rather than as hands-on practice
senses.definitionCN: 以原理和书本而非动手实践来教授的那部分内容
senses.example: The course balances theory with six hours of lab work.
senses.exampleCN: 这门课把理论课与六小时实验课相平衡。
senses.why: In training, the viewing half and the doing half are separated. Theory class is where you watch and read before you are allowed to act.
senses.whyCN: 在培训中，“观看”的一半和“动手”的一半被分开。理论课就是你被允许动手之前观看与阅读的地方。

senses.title: Idle or unrealistic speculation
senses.definition: speculation that is impractical or disconnected from reality, often used with a critical tone
senses.definitionCN: 不切实际或脱离现实的推测，常带批评语气
senses.example: That is pure theory; no one has tried it on a real farm.
senses.exampleCN: 那纯粹是纸上谈兵；没人在真实农场里试过。
senses.why: When the stand is too far from the field, watching never turns into doing. The word then carries the old complaint against pure contemplation.
senses.whyCN: 当看台离球场太远，观看就永远变不成行动。这个词于是带上了对纯粹空想的古老抱怨。

intro.en: Theory comes from Greek theōria 'a looking at, contemplation', built on thea 'a view' and the spectator word theōros. Latin and French carried it to English, where it shifted from watching to explaining.
intro.cn: theory 来自希腊语 theōria“观看、沉思”，由 thea“景象”与“观看者”theōros 构成。经拉丁语与法语进入英语，语义从“观看”转向“解释”。

items.en: Thea meant a view or a sight, the thing seen. It survives in English words such as theatre, where the view is what the audience comes for.
items.cn: thea 意为景象、所见之物。它保留在 theatre 等英语词中——观众来剧院，正是为了那个“景象”。

items.en: Theōros was a spectator, and also an envoy sent to consult an oracle or to watch a sacred festival. Watching was a public and often official act.
items.cn: theōros 是观看者，也是被派去求神谕或观看宗教节庆的使者。观看是一种公共的、常常带官方性质的行动。

items.en: Theōria meant a looking at, contemplation, and later a body of speculative knowledge. Philosophy used it for the highest kind of seeing.
items.cn: theōria 意为观看、沉思，后来指思辨性的知识体系。哲学用它表示最高层次的“看”。

items.en: Latin borrowed theoria mainly in learned and theological writing. The word stayed close to contemplation rather than to practical skill.
items.cn: 拉丁语主要在学术与神学写作中借用 theoria。这个词始终贴近“沉思”，而不是实用技能。

items.en: French théorie reached English in the 16c. with the sense of a scheme of ideas, especially in mathematics and philosophy.
items.cn: 法语 théorie 于 16 世纪进入英语，义为观念体系，尤用于数学与哲学。

items.en: The scientific revolution fixed the modern sense: a tested explanation of evidence. The everyday sense of a guess is older and never disappeared.
items.cn: 科学革命固定了现代义：对证据的受检验解释。日常“猜测”义更古老，并且从未消失。

note.en: The first group is theory's own family; the second ranks explanation words by how much evidence they claim.
note.cn: 第一组是 theory 自身的词族；第二组按“声称有多少证据”排列各种“解释”词。

entries.definition: concerned with ideas and principles rather than practice. It describes the mode, not the claim.
entries.definitionCN: 关乎观念与原理而非实践的。它描述方式，而不是主张。

entries.definition: a person who develops or studies theories.
entries.definitionCN: 建立或研究理论的人；理论家。

entries.definition: to form theories or speculate about something.
entries.definitionCN: 建立理论；对某事进行推测。

entries.definition: a statement proven from axioms, not a general explanation. It shares the Greek root but is a different kind of claim.
entries.definitionCN: 由公理证明的命题，不是一般性解释。它共享希腊词根，但主张的类型不同。

entries.definition: a proposed explanation to be tested. It is explicitly provisional, where theory may be either tested or loose.
entries.definitionCN: 有待检验的提议性解释。它明确是暂定的，而 theory 可能是已验证的，也可能松散。

entries.definition: a body of beliefs taught by a church, party, or school. It stresses authority rather than evidence.
entries.definitionCN: 教会、政党或学派所传授的信念体系。它强调权威，而非证据。

entries.definition: a basic rule or truth that explains how something works. It is usually narrower than a theory.
entries.definitionCN: 解释某物如何运作的基本规则或真理。它通常比 theory 窄。

entries.definition: guessing about something without firm evidence. It matches the everyday and critical senses of theory.
entries.definitionCN: 在没有确凿证据的情况下猜测。它对应 theory 的日常义与批评义。

entries.definition: an opinion formed from incomplete information. It is formal and openly admits the lack of proof.
entries.definitionCN: 根据不完整信息形成的看法。它较正式，并公开承认缺乏证据。

normalIntro.en: Real parts only: Greek thea 'view' and theōros 'spectator' give theōria 'a looking at'. Family words theory, theoretical, theorist, theorize, theorem.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实成分：希腊语 thea“景象”与 theōros“观看者”构成 theōria“观看”。词族为 theory、theoretical、theorist、theorize、theorem。

normal.en: The theatre and theory share thea: both are about a view.
normal.cn: theatre 与 theory 共享 thea：两者都与“看”有关。

normal.en: A theorist is a spectator who writes down what the game explains.
normal.cn: 理论家就是一位把比赛所说明的东西写下来的观众。

normal.en: In theory is the view from the stand; in practice is the play on the field.
normal.cn: in theory 是看台上的视角；in practice 是球场上的踢法。

normal.en: A theorem is proved; a theory is supported. Different strength of claim.
normal.cn: theorem 是被证明的；theory 是被支持的。主张的强度不同。

normal.en: My theory about the vase is just watching turned into guessing.
normal.cn: 我对花瓶事件的 theory，只是把“看见”变成了“猜测”。

abstract.en: Theory is the distance we put between seeing and acting, in order to see better.
abstract.cn: 理论，是我们在“看见”与“行动”之间拉开的距离，为了看得更清楚。

abstract.en: A theory that cannot be wrong is not a theory but a belief.
abstract.cn: 不可能出错的理论不是理论，而是信念。

abstract.en: Every practice is watched by some theory, even when the practitioner denies it.
abstract.cn: 每种实践都被某种理论注视着，即使实践者否认这一点。

examples.en: Darwin's theory took decades to be accepted by biologists.
examples.cn: 达尔文的理论花了几十年才被生物学家接受。

examples.en: The theory of harmony is easier to learn with a keyboard nearby.
examples.cn: 手边有键盘时，和声学理论更容易学。

examples.en: In theory the vaccine is free, but clinics still charge an admin fee.
examples.cn: 理论上疫苗是免费的，但诊所仍收取管理费。

dict_mnemonic.text: “思理论”——坐在看台上边看边思，慢慢就成了理论 → theory 理论、学说

root: 源自希腊语 theōria“观看、沉思”，由 thea“景象”与 theōros“观看者”构成；核心是“先看，再解释”。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of theory, all one act of watching: from the spectator's view grows a tested explanation, a doctrine, a set of principles, a guess, a classroom subject, or empty speculation.
sensesIntro.cn: theory 的八个义项都源自同一个“观看”动作：从观看者的视角生长出受检验的解释、学说、原理、猜测、课堂科目，或空洞的思辨。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: spectators in a stand, watching a game and trying to explain it.
core.cn: 核心意象：看台上的观众，看着一场比赛并试图解释它。

branches.en: EXPLANATION: the same frame is a tested theory when the evidence is in, and a hypothesis when it is not.
branches.cn: 解释：同一框架在证据齐备时是受检验的理论，证据未到时是假设。

branches.en: DOCTRINE: a named school turns one explanation into a whole body of teaching.
branches.cn: 学说：一个有名字的学派把单一解释变成整套教导。

branches.en: PRINCIPLES: the rules behind a craft, whether written in a book or taught in a theory class.
branches.cn: 原理：一门技艺背后的规则，无论写在书里还是在理论课上讲授。

branches.en: SPECULATION: everyday guessing and idle theorizing are watching that never reaches the field.
branches.cn: 推测：日常猜测与空洞空论，都是从未落到球场上的观看。

branches.en: IN THEORY: the stand's viewpoint set explicitly against the field's practice.
branches.cn: 理论上：把看台的视角明确摆到球场的实践对面。

intro.en: Theory's family is built on the Greek root for viewing. English adds -etical, -ist, -ize, and -em, while theorem keeps a distinct mathematical path.
intro.cn: theory 的词族建立在希腊语“观看”词根上。英语加 -etical、-ist、-ize、-em；theorem 则走出一条不同的数学路径。

latinIntro.en: The Latin forms are theoria 'contemplation', theorema 'a thing looked at, a theorem', and the Late Latin adjective theoricus.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁形式是 theoria“沉思”、theorema“被观看之物、定理”，以及晚期拉丁形容词 theoricus。

items.meaning: based on ideas and principles rather than practice
items.meaningCN: 基于观念与原理而非实践的（-etical 构成形容词）
items.example: The paper is purely theoretical and offers no data.
items.exampleCN: 这篇论文纯属理论，没有提供数据。

items.meaningCN: 理论上；按原理（-ly 构成副词）
items.example: Theoretically, the reaction should finish in an hour.
items.exampleCN: 理论上，这个反应应在一小时内完成。

items.meaning: a person who develops or studies theories
items.example: Literary theorists disagree about the author's intention.
items.exampleCN: 文学理论家对作者意图的看法不一。

items.meaningCN: 建立理论；推测（-ize 构成动词）
items.example: They theorized about the cause of the collapse.
items.exampleCN: 他们对坍塌的原因进行了理论推测。

items.meaningCN: 理论化；建立理论的过程（-ation 构成动作名词）
items.example: The book mixes fieldwork with heavy theorization.
items.exampleCN: 这本书把田野调查与大量理论化混在一起。

items.meaningCN: 由公理证明的命题；定理
items.example: The theorem holds for every prime greater than two.
items.exampleCN: 该定理对每个大于二的素数都成立。

items.meaning: according to principle, not necessarily in fact
items.meaningCN: 理论上；按理说（未必符合事实）
items.example: In theory, the two systems can run together.
items.exampleCN: 理论上，这两个系统可以同时运行。

items.meaning: the explanation of species change by natural selection
items.meaningCN: 进化论；以自然选择解释物种变化的理论
items.example: The theory of evolution rests on fossil and genetic evidence.
items.exampleCN: 进化论建立在化石与遗传学证据之上。

items.meaning: a lesson teaching principles rather than practice
items.meaningCN: 理论课；讲授原理而非实践的课程
items.example: Theory class meets on Monday; the lab is on Wednesday.
items.exampleCN: 理论课在周一，实验课在周三。

items.meaning: an explanation that claims a secret plot by powerful groups
items.meaningCN: 阴谋论；声称有权势集团秘密策划的解释
items.example: The rumour grew into a full conspiracy theory.
items.exampleCN: 这个传言发展成了完整的阴谋论。

latinEntries.structure: Latin noun borrowed from Greek theōria

latinEntries.meaning: a thing looked at, a proposition, a theorem

latinEntries.structure: Late Latin adjective from Greek theōrikos

definition_zh: 治疗；疗法；心理治疗
definition_en: the treatment of a physical or mental condition, especially without surgery or drugs
core_image: 每周同一时间推开的那扇门：把伤处摊开在有光照的地方
scene: 她在楼下列了整整一周的康复课表。The knee healed faster after two months of therapy.
sceneCN: 这里 therapy 是「治疗；康复治疗」（第 1 个义项：对身体的非药物系统治疗）；句意：经过两个月的治疗，膝盖好得更快了。

pos.zh: 治疗；疗法；心理治疗

derivatives.zh: 治疗师；治疗专家（therapy 加表人后缀 -ist 构成）
治疗的；有疗效的（同根形容词，经拉丁语进入英语）
有疗效地；治疗上（therapeutic 加副词后缀）
心理治疗（psycho- 加 therapy 复合）

senses.title: Treatment for a physical condition
